description: This PHP script initializes the environment for the inventory page, retrieves inventory data and user information from the database, processes the data to replace owner IDs with login names, and outputs the data as JSON. It is part of the TestLink project and handles inventory data retrieval.

classes.name: tlInventory
classes.description: Class responsible for handling inventory data, instantiated with test project ID and database connection, provides method getAll() to retrieve inventory entries.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Class responsible for user-related operations, instantiated with user ID, provides method getNames() to retrieve user login names.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all inventory data for the specified test project.

methods.name: getNames
methods.description: Retrieves a mapping of user IDs to login names.

methods.name: testlinkInitPage
methods.description: Initializes page environment, likely setting up database connection and session.
